title: 52 Chinese Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Chinese for Beginners (Family & Home)
description:
Learn 52 essential Chinese phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Chinese #LearnChinese #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 中文, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Chinese with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 52 real-life phrases
- 中文 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Family & Home · 家庭与家居
1:22  Banking & Money · 银行与金钱
2:29  Purpose · 目标
3:47  Sports & Fitness · 运动与健身
5:21  Hope · 希望
6:39  Kindness · 善良
8:03  Strength · 力量
9:23  Hotel & Accommodation · 酒店与住宿

PHRASE LIST

FAMILY & HOME · 家庭与家居
• How was dinner at home? - 你家晚饭怎么样？  [Ni JIA wan FAN zen me yang?]
• I’ll do the dishes today. - 今天我来洗碗。  [Jin TIAN wo LAI xi WAn.]
• Let’s hang up the coats. - 我们把外套挂起来吧。  [Wo MEN ba wai TAO gua qi LAI ba.]
• Mind your step, please. - 小心点，别摔着。  [Xiao xin dian, bie shuai ZHE.]
• The kitchen smells amazing. - 厨房闻起来太香了。  [Chu Fang wen qi LAI tai xiang le.]
• Did you lock the door? - 你锁门了吗？  [Ni suo MEN le ma?]
• I love our little routines. - 我喜欢我们的小习惯。  [Wo xi huan wo MEN de xiao xi guan.]

BANKING & MONEY · 银行与金钱
• I’d like to open an account. - 我想开一个账户。  [Wǒ xiǎng kāi yí gè zhànghù.]
• Is there a minimum balance? - 最低存款要求是多少？  [Zuìdī cúnkuǎn yāoqiú shì duō shao?]
• Can I transfer money today? - 我今天可以转账吗？  [Wǒ jīntiān kěyǐ zhuǎnzhàng ma?]
• How fast will it clear? - 这笔钱多久能到账？  [Zhè bǐ qián duōjiǔ néng dào zhàng?]
• What interest rate do you offer? - 你们的利率是多少？  [Nǐmen de lìlǜ shì duō shao?]
• I need to set up alerts. - 我想开通短信提醒。  [Wǒ xiǎng kāitōng duǎnxìn tímíng.]

PURPOSE · 目标
• My goal is simple, start now. - 我的目标很简单，先开始。  [Wǒ de mùbiāo hěn jiǎndān, xiān kāishǐ.]
• I choose one clear direction today. - 我今天选定一个清晰方向。  [Wǒ jīntiān xuǎndìng yí gè qīngxī fāngxiàng.]
• What outcome do I want most? - 我最想要的结果是什么？  [Wǒ zuì xiǎng yào de jiéguǒ shì shénme?]
• My target is progress, not perfection. - 我的目标是进步，不是完美。  [Wǒ de mùbiāo shì jìnbù, bú shì wánměi.]
• I set a deadline and move. - 我定个期限，然后行动。  [Wǒ dìng gè qīxiàn, ránhòu xíngdòng.]
• Break my goal into doable steps. - 把目标拆成做得到的步骤。  [Bǎ mùbiāo chāi chéng zuò dé dào de bùzhòu.]

SPORTS & FITNESS · 运动与健身
• I feel my core waking up - 我感觉核心在慢慢醒过来  [Wo GANjue he xin zai man man xing guo lai]
• Squeeze, hold, then breathe out - 用力收紧，停一停，再呼气  [Yong li shou jin, ting yi ting, zai hu qi]
• Light cardio, then cool down - 先做轻度有氧，再慢慢放松冷却  [Xian zuo qing du you yang, zai man man fang song leng que]
• My form matters more than speed - 动作要标准，速度不重要  [Dong zuo yao biao zhun, su du bu zhong yao]
• I’m training for strength, not show - 我练的是力量，不是为了表现  [Wo lian de shi li liang, bu shi wei le biao xian]
• Post-workout, I stretch for ten - 训练后我拉伸十分钟左右  [Xun lian hou wo la shen shi fen zhong zuo you]
• Keep my shoulders relaxed - 让肩膀放松下来  [Rang jian bang fang song xia lai]

HOPE · 希望
• Hope is in the next message - 希望在下一条消息里。  [Xīwàng zài xià tiáo xiāoxi lǐ.]
• I can try again, honestly - 我可以再试一次, 认认真真。  [Wǒ kěyǐ zài shì yí cì, RÈN REN ZHĒN.]
• Light choices lead to better days - 明智的小选择, 会带来更好的日子。  [Míngzhì de xiǎo xuǎnzé, huì dàilái gèng hǎo de rìzi.]
• Today I choose brave, not perfect - 今天我选勇敢, 不选完美。  [Jīntiān wǒ xuǎn yǒnggǎn, bù xuǎn wánměi.]
• Even my doubts can coexist - 就算有怀疑, 也可以并存希望。  [Jiùsuàn yǒu huáiyí, yě kěyǐ bìngcún xīwàng.]
• Something good is still possible - 还是有好事可能发生。  [Háishì yǒu hǎoshì kěnéng fāshēng.]

KINDNESS · 善良
• You don t have to fix everything - 你不必什么都去解决  [Ni bu bi shi me dou qu jie jue]
• Choose patience, even when busy - 忙也要先有耐心  [Mang ye yao xian you nai xin]
• Speak softly, it matters - 说话轻一点，很重要  [Shuo hua qing yi dian, hen zhong yao]
• Let them vent, just listen - 让他发泄一下, 你就听着  [Rang ta fa xie yi xia, ni jiu ting zhe]
• Your kindness changes the room - 你的善意会改变气氛  [Ni de shan yi hui gai bian qi fen]
• I appreciate your effort, truly - 我很感激你的用心  [Wo hen gan ji ni de yong xin]
• I ll help, no big deal - 我来帮你, 没关系  [Wo lai bang ni, mei guan xi]

STRENGTH · 力量
• I can handle the hard part - 我能扛住最难的那一段  [Wǒ néng KĀNZHÙ zuì nán de nà yī duàn]
• Keep going, even when it hurts - 继续走下去, 哪怕很疼也要走  [Jìxù zǒu xiàqù, nǎipà hěn TÉNG yě yào zǒu]
• I choose bravery, one decision - 我选择勇敢, 从一次决定开始  [Wǒ xuǎnzé Yǒnggǎn, cóng yī cì juédìng kāishǐ]
• Say it clearly, then act - 把话说清楚, 然后马上去做  [Bǎ huà shuō qīngchu, ránhòu mǎshàng qù zuò]
• I show up, even unmotivated - 我不等动力, 先去把事情做起来  [Wǒ bù děng dònglì, xiān qù bǎ shìqing zuò qǐlái]
• Strength means asking for help - 真正的力量, 是敢开口求助  [Zhēnzhèng de lìliang, shì gǎn kāikǒu qiúzhù]

HOTEL & ACCOMMODATION · 酒店与住宿
• Can I get late checkout, please? - 我可以晚一点退房吗？  [Wo ke yi WAN yi dian tui fang ma?]
• Is breakfast included in the rate? - 早餐包含在房费里吗？  [Zao can bao han zai fang fei li ma?]
